maximum_depth_rule: All 807 Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained as raw maximum-depth records. A source line may combine current values, target values, annotations, periods, and several series, so it is not promoted to a structured annual actual or future target without a reviewed field mapping.
large_file_boundary: The canonical source exceeds the GitHub Contents API inline-content limit but remains a non-empty repository blob. The normalizer and tests read the checked-out file directly in CI and reconcile all 807 records against the Phase 9 review summary.
non_goals: Do not parse mixed raw statements into inferred annual actual and future target values.
Do not replace missing units with inferred measurement units.
Do not collapse separate official documents into an inferred common table.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
